count_definitions.inaccessible: Neither the correct author abstract nor relevant original main text could be checked. Wrong local PDF with a correct abstract fallback is abstract_only.

metadata.dataset_policy: No dataset attribution from microscopy, organism, topics or citation proximity. Named dataset use requires explicit original methods/results/data-availability text and locator. Not established means unknown, not absent.
metadata.local_source_policy: Verify article identity from its own header/body, not filename or extraction metadata. Hash PDFs, compare extraction provenance, inspect relevant sections. Original local full texts remain local; public tracker contains paraphrases, locators, hashes and short excerpts only.
